name: Seychelles
about: Near year-round warmth; Apr–May and Oct–Nov are calmest between trade winds, Dec–Feb can be rainy and windy.
overview: Granite-boulder beaches and dense jungle spread across 115 islands, with some of the Indian Ocean's clearest water.
costOverview: Even self-catering and local takeaways run higher than most tropical destinations — there's no cheap version of the Seychelles.
monthlyWeather: warm and humid, with the year's heaviest rain from the northwest monsoon
